name: Mall Wall Module · 2 m
summary: A two-metre honed limestone wall with a bronze plinth, brass lip and two courses of cladding.
description: An original wall for the modular mall grid. Two-metre end sockets, a ground-centre pivot and three authored levels of detail support repeated interior runs.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original editor-ready Blender meshes, a procedural packed limestone image and authored PBR materials. All three levels are editable.
rights: Original project asset. Public download and redistribution terms have not been specified.

attribution.credit: Original Blender-3D-Gallery geometry, generated limestone texture, materials and render.

accuracy_notes: Fictional interior finish. The measured straight-run interfaces use this 2 m family. Physical-device performance, other wall systems and construction performance require separate assessment.
